statement: Intel guided Q3 2026 revenue to $15.8-16.8 billion with non-GAAP EPS of $0.38.
why: Guidance shows whether the vendor expects the compute spending wave to keep going into the next quarter.

impact.mechanism: A guided range above the just-reported quarter implies continued sequential growth in data-center and client compute demand.

evidence.excerpt: For Q3 2026, Intel guided revenue of $15.8-16.8 billion, GAAP EPS of $0.31, non-GAAP EPS of $0.38.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor guidance in the official earnings release; the value is the stated range midpoint.
